The /traiteur gallery's treatment B2 Mozaïek (D-45, gallery.css v1.1): tiles 1 and 6 wide 16:9, 2–5 square; each source cut to its tile at the focal point (item 3: the crop box first). Strings = lexicon §5.24 „30.10 — the gallery” + §6 „Grătar, 30.10” (RO lint 0). Preview: design/contact-sheets/review-2026-10-30/gallery-bbq-preview.jpg.
